definitions.explanation: Published or occurring every three months.

examples.japanese: この{雑誌|ざっし}は{季刊|きかん}で{発行|はっこう}されている。
{季刊|きかん}の{学術|がくじゅつ}{誌|し}
{当社|とうしゃ}の{季刊|きかん}レポートは{毎年|まいとし}3{月|がつ}、6{月|がつ}、9{月|がつ}、12{月|がつ}に{発行|はっこう}されます。
examples.english: Our quarterly report is published every year in March, June, September, and December.

notes:
Published every season (four times a year). Composed of {季|き} (season) + {刊|かん} (publication). Used as a modifier ({季刊|きかん}の) or in compound nouns ({季刊|きかん}{誌|し}).

PUBLICATION FREQUENCY SCALE:
- {日刊|にっかん}: daily
- {週刊|しゅうかん}: weekly
- {隔週刊|かくしゅうかん}: biweekly
- {月刊|げっかん}: monthly
- {季刊|きかん}: quarterly
- {年刊|ねんかん}: yearly/annual

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {季刊|きかん}{誌|し}: quarterly journal/magazine
- {季刊|きかん}で{発行|はっこう}する: to publish quarterly

HOMOPHONES:
{季刊|きかん} shares pronunciation with {期間|きかん} (period of time), {機関|きかん} (institution/engine), and {器官|きかん} (organ) — context and kanji distinguish them.
